researcher_notes: OPUS REDO PASS. Blind independent re-extraction of the KNAPP 'Open Shuttle' product folder (3 byte-identical copies in Analysed/, extracted once). No sonnet-era findings consulted. This is a MULTI-PRODUCT CATALOG: 34 pages covering FIVE distinct vehicles (Open Shuttle Fork, Open Shuttle 50, Open Shuttle 100, Open Shuttle Boxgrip, Open Shuttle 50 ASG) plus the KiSoft FCS fleet-control software and an accessories chapter. Each vehicle gets a spec page, a standard-features/add-on page, and a dedicated aisle-geometry page. Scope discipline: Open Shuttle Fork extracted against '*' + 'Logistics:AGV' + 'Logistics:AGV:Forklift' (its DB product_type); the other four against '*' + 'Logistics:AGV' + 'Logistics:AGV:AMR'. Document version '2025_02_de' (p.33). Language: German.

company_wide_context.applies_to: country / hq_city / certifications_generic / reference_count are Company- or Product-level (scope '*'). fleet_management_system, fleet_control_architecture, multi_fleet_capable, installation_process, modification_process and infrastructure_free are Base-Model-granularity fields in AP0, so at import time they must be FANNED OUT to every KNAPP base model individually — they cannot be written once centrally.
company_wide_context.notes: COMPANY-NAME MISMATCH (flag): the imprint on p.33 reads 'KNAPP Industry Solutions GmbH' while the DB company record is 'KNAPP AG'. Same group, different legal entity — the folder never mentions 'KNAPP AG'. Recorded against the existing KNAPP AG record but flagged rather than silently creating a second company. fleet_management_system CAVEAT: AP0's hint carries a NULL RULE warning against inferring this field from the mere presence of fleet software. Here the document devotes a whole chapter to a named, vendor-own fleet controller and explicitly offers it as a 'Stand-alone-Lösung für Open Shuttles' (p.27), which is a positive statement about the controller's architecture rather than an inference — hence 'Proprietary'. A reviewer may still prefer null. INFRASTRUCTURE_FREE CAVEAT (interesting nuance): the base claim is solid, but the accessories chapter offers 'Reflektoren — Reflektoren unterstützen die Open Shuttles bei der relativen Positionierung an Übergabestellen' (pp.30–31). So reflectors ARE available as an optional positioning aid at transfer points, even though the vehicles do not require them. Recorded true (the standard configuration needs no permanent site modification) with this noted. NAVIGATION_TYPE DELIBERATELY LEFT NULL FOR ALL FIVE PRODUCTS: the folder describes navigation only as 'Autonome, robuste, deterministische Navigation' (p.5) and never names a technology — no SLAM, no natural feature, no laser, no reflector-based localisation, nothing. All five DB rows carry navigation_type='Natural Feature (SLAM)', which this 34-page product folder does not support. Not contradicted, but conspicuously unsourced. VDA 5050 IS NEVER MENTIONED anywhere in the folder, yet all five DB rows carry vda5050_compatible=1. Same situation as the MiR group: absence is not denial, but this is the manufacturer's own full product folder. industries_served left null: p.5 says only 'In allen Industrien sofort einsetzbar', which names no vertical. SAFETY_COVERAGE — treated conservatively for all five: 'CE-zertifiziert' is standard everywhere, but 3D sensing is consistently an ADD-ON, not standard — '3D-Hinderniserkennung' is listed under ADD-ON for the Fork (p.7) and the 50 ASG (p.23), and for the 50/100/Boxgrip the equivalent add-on is the 'Top-Scanner', described as 'bildet eine zweite Scan-Ebene zur Positionserkennung' (pp.11, 15, 19). The p.5 marketing headline ('Maximale Sicherheit: 3D-Hinderniserkennung, Blue-Light und Signalleuchten') does not override the per-product ADD-ON labelling. All five therefore get 'Single plane (2D)' for the standard configuration.

products.notes: ENRICH — no conflict. Both values the DB already holds are confirmed exactly: max_payload=1300 (p.6) and lifting_height=1200 (p.6 'Übergabehöhe 0 – 1.200 mm'), as is omnidirectional_movement=true (p.7 'Omnidirektionaler Antrieb'). MIN_AISLE_WIDTH — CONFIGURATION MATRIX COLLAPSED, documented per the multi-dimensional-matrix rule. p.9 prints FOUR aisle figures on two axes: traffic direction (Einbahn = one-way vs Gegenverkehr = two-way) × speed (vmin ≤0,3 m/s vs vmax 1,5 m/s): Einbahn/vmin 1.400 mm, Einbahn/vmax 1.950 mm, Gegenverkehr/vmin 2.700 mm, Gegenverkehr/vmax 3.500 mm. AP0 has no field for either axis. Choice made: the Gegenverkehr figures were DISCARDED because two-way traffic is a layout decision, not a property of one vehicle; within the Einbahn column the CONSERVATIVE (larger) vmax figure 1.950 mm was taken, since min_aisle_width is KO_IF_GT and quoting the 1.400 mm speed-restricted figure would overstate the vehicle. The p.9 note 'Angegebene Werte beziehen sich auf Euro-Paletten' means all four figures assume a Euro pallet load. NOT MAPPED — 'Drehkreis 2.700 mm' (p.9): 'Drehkreis' is a turning CIRCLE (diameter), not a radius, so per the standing radius-vs-diameter rule it is not converted or mapped. It is doubly unmappable here anyway, since neither turning_radius (Tugger scope) nor min_turning_radius (AMR scope) exists for a Forklift AGV. NOT MAPPED — no AP0 field: 'Max. Ladungsträgergröße 1.200 x 1.200 x 2.300 mm, größer auf Anfrage' (p.6); the p.9 clearance callouts (100 mm / 225 mm / 100 mm); 'Elektrisch ohne Scherenhub — Integrierter Hub' (p.7); 'ESD-tauglich — Produktsicherheit' (p.7, all five vehicles); add-ons 'Blue-Light', 'Bürsten', 'Fahrwerk' (p.7); the accessories chapter (pp.29–32: Fernbedienung, Türsteuerung Digital I/O, Ladestation, Serviceladegerät, Servicegestell, Servicewagen, Chep-Paletten-Adapter, stationäre Stellplatzüberwachung, Durchlaufregale, Reflektoren). LEFT NULL DELIBERATELY: navigation_type (no technology named anywhere — see company_wide_context); stacking_capability (DB has 1; the folder documents a 0–1.200 mm transfer height but never states stacking/de-stacking of pallets on top of each other); drive_type (no counterbalanced/reach/straddle designation given); vda5050_compatible (never mentioned; DB has 1). SCOPE BUG IN EXISTING DB ROW (pre-existing): product_type='Forklift AGV' but the row carries grid_required, rotation_capable and rack_pin_compatible — all three scope 'Logistics:AGV:AMR'.

products.variant_group: Container shuttle family. Open Shuttle 50 / 100 / 50 ASG / Boxgrip share the same drive concept (Differentialantrieb), battery (LiFePo4), CE and ESD status and 1,5 m/s top speed, and all have a ~1.79 m body height — strong candidate for one base model with four load-handling variants. They differ in footprint, load-handling unit (roller conveyor vs gripper) and payload. Grouping decision left to the import-script author.

products.notes: NEW — but flagged as a POSSIBLE DUPLICATE OF AN EXISTING DB ROW, needs a Tech Lead decision. The DB holds a generic product simply called 'Open Shuttle' (Mobile AMR, max_payload=120) alongside the specific 'KNAPP Open Shuttle 100', 'KNAPP Open Shuttle 50 ASG' and 'KNAPP Open Shuttle Boxgrip'. This folder documents no generic 'Open Shuttle' — chapter 3 covers 'Open Shuttle 50' and 'Open Shuttle 100' as two named models. Since the generic DB row's 120 kg payload matches BOTH the 50 and the 100, it is most likely the un-suffixed ancestor of 'Open Shuttle 50'. Recommend renaming the existing 'Open Shuttle' row to 'KNAPP Open Shuttle 50' and enriching it, rather than creating a second row — but that is a rename of an existing record, so it is flagged here, not proposed as data. NOT MAPPED — AP0 SCOPE GAP (recurring): p.13 gives a full aisle-geometry page — Einbahn (vmin) 1.250 mm, Einbahn (vmax) 1.800 mm, Gegenverkehr (vmin) 2.450 mm, Gegenverkehr (vmax) 2.950 mm, plus 'Andockbereich 1.800 mm' and 'Optimum 400 mm' — but min_aisle_width exists only in Forklift and Tugger scope, so NONE of it can be stored for a Mobile AMR. This is the same gap hit for MiR and Hikrobot earlier in this session. NOT MAPPED — semantics don't fit: 'Abgabe- und Aufnahmehöhen 500 mm – 1.500 mm' (p.10) is the transfer-STATION height range the shuttle can serve. The nearest AP0 field, cart_pickup_height_range, is defined as 'Range of cart/carrier heights the hook/lift can collect without modifying existing carts' — a different quantity (cart height, not station height) — so it was deliberately left null. Likewise the optional 'Integrierter Hub ermöglicht Abgabehöhen von 550 bis 1.500 mm' (p.11) was not written to lift_height, which AP0 defines as the stroke that raises a cart/rack/pod off the floor. NOT MAPPED — no AP0 field: 'Max. Ladungsträgergröße 600 x 400 mm'; body height 1.794 mm (this is not an under-ride robot, so min_ground_clearance's 'drive UNDER the carrier' semantics do not apply); 'Differentialantrieb — Fahrkonzept und Fahrwerk'; 'ESD-tauglich'; add-ons 'Blue-Light', 'Bürsten', 'Stellplatzsensor' ('überprüft vor Abgabe eines Behälters, ob der Stellplatz frei ist. Eine stationäre Sensorik ist somit nicht erforderlich'), 'Top-Scanner'. LEFT NULL: navigation_type, vda5050_compatible (see company_wide_context).
